t.E469.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E469.body: Celluloses are not absorbed and are largely excreted unchanged in faeces; part of them may be fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E469.prod: It is produced by partial breakdown of carboxymethyl cellulose with the enzyme cellulase.
t.E469.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E469.summary: A thickener produced from cellulose with enzymes. It is used as a thickener and stabiliser.
t.E469.what: It thickens and is used as a stabiliser.
